name: How long does a cast iron drain pipe replacement typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a cast iron drain pipe replacement typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a cast iron drain pipe replacement varies significantly based on the scope of work, including the amount of piping to be replaced and accessibility. A small section replacement might take 1-2 days, while a full home repipe could span several days to over a week. For properties in areas like Henderson or Summerlin, our team provides a detailed timeline after the initial assessment, ensuring you have a clear understanding of the project's duration and any necessary preparations.
